history.content: Find the Series A deck Sarah sent and get it to our investor list.

The deck is located: "Series A Deck v4," attached to "Fwd: Series A deck" from Sarah's partner at the VC firm, and Sarah's own follow up ("send the updated deck when you can") confirms that's the current version. Two things before it goes out: 1. Who's on the investor list? I don't have a saved list, send me the names or emails. 2. Forward the original email with the attachment, or share via Drive link? And any note you want on top, or send as is? I have not checked a fresh web check this turn, so I can't confirm anything that depends on it.
